column1: # The `doom` gate's scenario: /bin/doom, with the shareware IWAD installed at
# /usr/share/games/doom/doom1.wad (the directory the platform layer makes the
# working directory, because doomgeneric is built without ORIGCODE and searches
# The marker is the platform layer's own verdict, not the engine's: once Doom
# has rendered a frame with more than a handful of distinct pixels, the layer
# reads one pixel back out of the /dev/fb mapping and compares it with the
# source pixel it just wrote, then prints `doom: PASS`. A mapping that is not
# the live framebuffer, a blank frame, or a blit that never ran all fail it.
# The engine is in its attract loop (title screen, then the demo episodes) and
# would never return, so the step passes `-minix-exit`: the platform layer leaves
# once its verdict is printed and the shell has a prompt again. The command is
# typed paced, because a console that loses a byte in a long unpaced line turns
# an argument into a different one.
